title: Daily dynamic assessment and modelling of intersession processes in ambulatory psychotherapy: A proof of concept study
limitations: - Small sample size; - Lack of diversity in sample; - Psychometric concerns about single-item scales for emotions; - Potential for measurement effects due to daily questioning.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the main text, but supplementary materials or repositories may exist. The authors used the DynAMo software package for data collection.
